svg.title: 04 OFFSET SHELL R01 — two seam finish trials (not a garment pattern)

g.text: 04 OFFSET SHELL / SEAM FINISH TRIAL
TOHEŞAR OBJECT LAB | R01 / UNAPPROVED / 2026-11-15
Two 160 mm straight stitch-line trials; same fabric, needle, stitch length and handling.
NOT a production pattern. Use offcuts, not the official artwork or a garment.
A / FOUR-THREAD OVERLOCK + PRESS TO LOWER PANEL
Test bulk, seam visibility and wash-induced puckering. No tape.
B / SAME SEAM + LIGHTWEIGHT STABILIZING TAPE
Test whether tape prevents waviness or instead stiffens the diagonal.
UPPER A / cut strip 180 × 20 mm
LOWER A / cut strip 180 × 20 mm
Align red notches at 40/80/120 mm from stitch-line start. Sew on dashed lines.
Overlock raw edges together; press allowance toward lower panel.
Observe seam roll, ridge, and distortion before/after laundering.
UPPER B / cut strip 180 × 20 mm
LOWER B / cut strip 180 × 20 mm
Apply removable trial tape to upper seam allowance only, without stretch.
Tape width/composition = record actual chosen material; no supplier spec assumed.
Sew same as A. Compare drape, ridge, puckering and laundering.
CONTROLLED RECORD (write actual values)
Fabric composition / knit / GSM (seller vs measured): ____________________________
Cut direction relative to wale/grain (A and B must match): _______________________
Needle / thread / stitch length / overlock settings: _____________________________
Tape type / width / adhesion / wash compatibility: _____________________________
A seam waviness / thickness / comfort / wash: ________________________________
B seam waviness / thickness / comfort / wash: ________________________________
Decision: A / B / NEITHER. Attach front, reverse and side-light photos.
HOLD: 160 mm straight coupon cannot validate full curved diagonal, shrinkage, or fit.
